title: Ticketto message envelope
description: Every message body on a publisher's exchange (event.events, checkout.events, ...). The message-specific content is in `payload` and has its own <MessageName>.payload.schema.json. This is the format event-service publishes and queue-service parses (app/messaging/schemas.py).

message_id.description: UUID. Also sent as the AMQP message_id property; consumers deduplicate on it.

message_type.description: PascalCase message name from topology/messages.yaml. Also the AMQP type property. Not the routing key: that is the message's dotted routing_key.

schema_version.description: Version of this message's payload schema. Consumers reject versions they don't know.

occurred_at.description: UTC, ISO 8601 with a Z suffix.

producer.description: The publishing service, as named in topology/messages.yaml.
